name: Powkiddy RGB30
identify: helperFunctions.sh: /proc/cpuinfo part 0xd05 (RK3566) + /etc/os-release OS_NAME=DARKMOSS, SPRUCE_PLATFORM=RGB30 (or, pre-stamp images, the HW_DEVICE fallback)

vol.note: event1 adc-keys reports only a phantom 114 and is rejected by the resolver

L3.note: doubles as MENU in the default Button Settings > Menu button = L3 setting

R3.note: plain stick click by default; becomes MENU instead of L3 if Button Settings > Menu button is set to R3

MENU.note: the default (L3) branch of the Button Settings > Menu button jq check in RGB30.cfg; not a dedicated button

VOL_UP.note: dArkMossCommon.cfg default; the Standard/Swapped setting is read at boot (see notes)

VOL_DOWN.note: dArkMossCommon.cfg default; the Standard/Swapped setting is read at boot (see notes)

notes: No dedicated MENU button: by default a tap of L3 (1 317) is both L3 and MENU (Button Settings > Menu button, default L3); the alternative setting swaps this so R3 (1 318) is MENU instead and L3 stays a plain stick click. The code/source below is the default (L3) branch; the other stick click (R3 by default) is a plain click with no MENU role.
Volume rocker may be hardware-swapped on some units; Button Settings > Volume buttons "Swapped" flips B_VOLUP/DOWN to 1 114/1 115 instead of the dArkMossCommon default 1 115/1 114 used below.
No rumble motor from the factory (the PWM and FF_RUMBLE are present for a solder mod); unrelated to Button Reader but may confuse a tester expecting feedback.
